changelog: - **Export everything about one company as one JSON file** (#2435, under #2396). New `GET /api/companies/[id]/export`, reached from a download button on each card on `/admin/companies`: the company row plus its needs, requisitions, offers (those naming this company, and those with no company on one of its relations; an offer naming another company stays out), shortlist interests, the `CompanyInquiry` rows it was converted from, its mentorship relations (people as `id`/`fullName`/`email` only), and those relations' `InteractionLog` and `StatusChange` rows. Shaped on `/api/account/export`: `Content-Disposition: attachment` with a `[a-z0-9-]` slug filename (a free-text company name never reaches the header), `Cache-Control: no-store`. ADMIN only, and not behind an impersonated session: MENTOR and COMPANY, who may read the company, get 403 plus an `authz.scope_denied` row, because a per-role file would have to re-prove every column against every read route. The company is looked up through `scopeForRole(user, 'company')` AND a flag-independent `orgScoped(…, resolveOrgId(session))` (#2542 pattern), so another org's company is a 404 even with `MT_ENFORCE_ISOLATION` off. Every served file writes one `company.export` `ActivityLog` row (no repeat suppression, no company name in `detail`); a 404 writes nothing. No new table, no schema change. Documented in `docs/role-access-matrix.md`; pinned by `e2e/company-export.spec.ts` (the cross-org 404 is `@smoke`) and a new row in `e2e/fixtures/authz-matrix.ts`.

en: Admins can now download everything stored about one company as a single JSON file, from the new download button on each company card. Each download is recorded in the activity log.
tr: Yöneticiler artık bir şirkete ait tüm kayıtları, her şirket kartındaki yeni indirme düğmesiyle tek bir JSON dosyası olarak indirebiliyor. Her indirme etkinlik kaydına yazılıyor.
de: Admins können jetzt alle zu einem Unternehmen gespeicherten Daten als eine einzige JSON-Datei herunterladen – über die neue Download-Schaltfläche auf jeder Unternehmenskarte. Jeder Download wird im Aktivitätsprotokoll erfasst.
